quarterly_data.signal: Jacobs Solutions 10-Q: Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities backlog was $28,429 million at June 26, 2026 versus $22,270 million a year earlier, predominantly driven by growth in the Advanced Manufacturing market (PA Consulting $459 million); remaining performance obligations were approximately $22.2 billion, about 45% expected within twelve months. Fiscal Q3 2026 I&AF revenue was $3,746,900 thousand (prior year $2,699,062 thousand) with segment operating profit of $268,125 thousand, and U.S. revenue was $2,808,323 thousand (prior year $1,862,762 thousand).
